scheme_name: State Disability Scholarship (Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities)
other_conditions: Student must be studying in Class I to Class VIII
Disability must be at least 40% as per benchmark disability
Student must be enrolled in an institution that has a valid AISHE/UDISE code
Students who have failed in their last examination (repeaters) are not eligible
Applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme
Scholarship applies to all types of disabilities as defined in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules 2017
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹200 (subject to variation as per Government of Nagaland guidelines) are provided to eligible physically disabled students in Classes I to VIII.
